// Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

import type { Transport } from '../../core/transport.js';
import { EmbeddingsResource } from './embeddings.js';
import { FilesResource } from './files.js';

export * from './embeddings.js';
export * from './files.js';

/**
 * Every resource group exposed on the client, keyed by its accessor name.
 */
export interface Resources {
  readonly embeddings: EmbeddingsResource;
  readonly files: FilesResource;
}

export function createResources(client: Transport): Resources {
  return {
    embeddings: new EmbeddingsResource(client),
    files: new FilesResource(client),
  };
}
